Repair CheckedPMap.create recursive key/value construction and optional pmap_field factory to forward the already-declared ignore_extra policy. Validate multiple map/record/class levels and optional None, not only a single shallow example.

Repair _make_seq_field_type caching so CheckedPVector/CheckedPSet same item_type but different item_invariant identity never reuse an incompatible class; same callable identity reuses safely including unhashable callable objects, without equality/hash assumptions on the policy. New generated-type pickle reductions carry the actual pickleable invariant or an explicit None default marker and reconstruct under that exact policy. Legacy three-argument payloads lack enough policy information: reject with a clear trusted-model migration instruction; an explicit fourth policy/default marker supports deliberate restoration. Preserve ordinary default-field pickle roundtrips and class names without silently decoding old ambiguous data under a wrong invariant.

Add pyrsistent.merge.deep_merge(left,right,conflict="replace",max_depth=32) and MergeConflict.path. left is a PMap and right accepts mapping or pairs through the earlier delivered update capability. Merge mapping/mapping branches recursively, leaf conflicts replace by default, raise with full tuple path or call an explicit (path,old,new) resolver. Equal/unmodified values share existing branches; new builtin containers are frozen with strict=False to preserve already-persistent checked types. Use actual evolvers, preserve CheckedPMap validation, reject unsupported policy/depth and surface type/source/callback failures without changing left. Do not claim automatic concatenation of sequences, arbitrary object deepcopy or a concurrent transaction. Cyclic/unrepresentable new builtin containers fail explicitly.
